privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Mhitaryan we take your privacy seriously. Here is a short, honest account of what data we handle and how.
privacy.analyticsText: We use Umami, a privacy-focused analytics tool, to see how visitors use this site — which pages get read and roughly where visitors come from. Umami does not use cookies, does not collect personal data, and does not track you across other websites. All data is hosted in the EU. Analytics data is kept for up to six months and then deleted automatically.
privacy.contactText: If you email us or use a contact form, we use that information only to respond to you. We don't add you to a mailing list or share it with third parties.
privacy.rightsText: Under the GDPR, you can ask us what personal data we hold about you, correct it, or have it deleted. Since our analytics don't collect personal data, this mainly concerns information you've sent us directly, such as by email. Reach us at
privacy.changesText: We may update this policy occasionally. The current version is always the one posted here.
